🔭 Team/personal "AI work OS" products — ready alternatives to the hand-rolled setup

TL;DR: The category is real and crowded, but no product ships the whole concept. Closest: Claude Team + Cowork (the productized version of your rig — org-provisioned skills, cloud scheduled tasks, admin guardrails; your .claude/skills carry over as-is), Dust ($30/seat multiplayer agent OS, Claude-capable, self-serve), Notion Custom Agents (agents read AND write a human-curated workspace, memory as pages with version history). Nobody automates corrections → durable team rules — the self-learning loop stays DIY everywhere; that's your moat and the Jumpstart services wedge.

Key points:
• Own team: pilot Claude Team + Cowork — skills port as-is; Dust is the multi-model fallback (tier 1–2)
• Clients: pick by stack — M365 → Copilot Studio (skills GA only Dec '26), Atlassian → Rovo (bundled), neutral/EU → Dust, governance-led → Glean (~100-seat min; 3rd-party pricing)
• Ruled out: Sana (absorbed into Workday), Manus (China ownership review, weak guardrails), Writer (no Claude), Gemini Enterprise (paywalled + twice renamed) (tier 1–2)
• Market signal: OpenAI Workspace Agents = team "skills" library in research preview; Frontier is F500-gated; Anthropic Managed Agents API = the same concept as infrastructure (tier 1–2)
